Enter the smaller of line 1 or line 2 here ... 4. Enter the amount from line 3 here and on Form 4562, line 1". Project $2,500,000.00, model $0.00 ("Worksheet 1: smaller of cost 0.00 or 2,500,000 = 0.00"). The model followed Worksheet 1, whose line 3 takes the smaller of the cost of 2025 section 179 property and $2,500,000; that is the alternative reading recorded in amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property, and the owner adopted line 1 as the $2,500,000 the line 1 instruction states (TASKS T-043; ambiguities/research/amb.2025.s179_carryover_no_property.md). Lines 12 and 13 agree in this case (the model left lines 6 to 11 blank because its line 5 is zero; there is no 2025 property and no carryover). The model's value is the non-chosen reading, so it is dropped from the fixture; lines 1 and 5 stay asserted by the hand-predicted stage14.s179 cases. (carried over from reviews/2025/classm/s179.index.json at 26f283ec, review of 2026-10-26)
